{{Top|leg}}
'''Freelol''' was a liquid [[Coolant/Legends|cooling agent]]. It was used in [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] such as the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] to cool vital components during firing. On the E-11, freelol was forced through the weapon's integrated capillary system by [[cooling coil]]s on the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
